SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0), 2) AS total_spent
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
LIMIT 100;

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(MAX(total_amount), 0), 2) AS largest_purchase_amount
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(tax_amount), 0), 2) AS total_tax
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'

SELECT
    LOWER(category) AS category,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0), 2) AS total_spent
FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
GROUP BY LOWER(category)
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT vendor_name,

FROM transactions
WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
GROUP BY vendor_name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 1;

WHERE user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'

  AND (vendor_name LIKE '%electricity%' OR vendor_name LIKE '%utility%')

SELECT

    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(ti.total_price), 0), 2) AS total_spent
FROM transaction_items ti
JOIN transactions t ON ti.transaction_id = t.id
WHERE t.user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'
GROUP BY ti.item_name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC

JOIN transactions tr ON ti.transaction_id = tr.id
WHERE tr.user_id = '01c9ef3d-7c4b-5cfa-a341-e46e6f3a8362'

SELECT
    t.id,
    t.date,
    t.vendor_name,
    t.total_amount,
    t.category,
    t.payment_method,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ti.item_name) AS distinct_item_count
FROM transactions t
JOIN transaction_items ti ON ti.transaction_id = t.id
WHERE t.user_id = '3f0a1212-d35d-5ebe-96ae-3bce34b8a85f'
GROUP BY t.id, t.date, t.vendor_name, t.total_amount, t.category, t.payment_method
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ti.item_name) > 2
LIMIT 100;

    COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(t.total_amount), 2), 0) AS total_yoga_membership
